name: Aftermarket HQ
old_description: At Aftermarket HQ, we combine top-tier craftsmanship, cutting-edge technology, and real-world expertise to deliver vehicles that perform as hard as you do. Whether it’s suspension systems, custom fabrication, or complete off-road builds, our work speaks for itself — built by enthusiasts, for enthusiasts.
about:
Aftermarket HQ operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where it has served the off-road community for over a decade. The shop was established by enthusiasts who wanted a destination that combined parts retail with hands-on fabrication and tuning, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The team includes Walt, Evan, Vanessa, and Jamie, who are referenced in customer testimonials as the faces behind the counter and the builds.

The business stocks and installs performance components for late-model trucks and SUVs — primarily Ford F-150, Raptor, Bronco, and Ranger platforms. Its catalog covers LED lighting from Baja Designs, stainless-steel downpipes from SPD, third-party brake-light assemblies with integrated Starlink mounts from SwarfWorks, switch-panel power systems, and wiring harnesses. In-house services span suspension upgrades, custom fabrication, complete vehicle builds, ECU flashing, and powder-coating in a matte fine-textured black finish.

Customers are recreational and competitive off-roaders who run desert dunes, rock trails, and daily-driven rigs. The shop's work is validated in the same environments its clients drive: the Mojave Desert, Dumont Dunes, and local trail networks. Buyers range from first-time modifiers to owners of six-figure custom builds who return for follow-up tuning and service.

The company positions its edge on lived experience — every product sold has been tested on the terrain it's meant for, and every build is tuned on-site. That "built by enthusiasts, for enthusiasts" ethos, coupled with 10-plus years of continuous operation in the Las Vegas Valley, is cited as the reason customers trust the shop with high-value vehicles.
